scientific_integrity: Uniform intrinsic-volume normalization uses the zero-sum Euclidean hyperplane; lattice counting uses the dual type-A root lattice. Every term has an explicit range-classification proof. No independent audit or external mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the deleted-star family is classified. The matching comparison applies for 2 <= k <= floor(n/2). No extremality over all deletion configurations or h-star real-rootedness is proved. A prior equivalent height-function enumeration is a remaining historical-priority risk. The all-parameter result is analytically proved; finite checker instances are corroborative.
title: Exact Ehrhart polynomial and a strict deletion-clustering effect for star-deleted complete graphs
